summary: Online multiplayer (WS matchmaking + realtime relay) for NEON PITCH STRIKER fully tested. Backend WebSocket at /api/ws pairs two clients (first waiting = host, second = guest), relays inputs & state, and notifies opponent on disconnect. Frontend MainMenu shows MAÇ BUL button, clicking it goes to Matchmaking screen with RAKİP ARANIYOR title, player card, VS spinner and IPTAL button. Two browser contexts both clicking MAÇ BUL get paired within ~200ms and both render the game canvas with identical scores/ball positions/timer. Guest's 'd' keyboard input moves the right-side player on BOTH host and guest windows (verified numerically via engineRef fiber inspection: ai.x went 1240 -> 1295 on both). IPTAL cancels matchmaking and returns to the main menu. No share-goal-btn and no goal-celebration React overlay exist.
critical_code_review_comments: matchmaking.py: `find_match` when called again by an already-matched player will not remove them from an active room; harmless (no waiting entry), but consider guarding with `if player.room_id: return`.
matchmaking.py protocol comment lists 'chat' as relay type but no client sends it; ok, but keeps surface small.
Game.js applyRemoteState: on guest side the `state.t <= 0` transition can double-fire before match_end arrives; both set STATE.ENDED so idempotent, minor.
engine.js: Player class 'controlled' field unused for host/guest logic beyond ai flag; consider naming clarity.

success_rate.frontend: 100% (9/9 checks: matchmaking screen, pairing, host/guest roles, scores match, ball pos consistent, guest input relayed to host, guest sees remote state, IPTAL returns menu, no share-goal-btn, no goal-celebration overlay)

context_for_next_testing_agent: WS endpoint at wss://<host>/api/ws. Use websockets lib. Pytest file at /app/backend/tests/test_matchmaking_ws.py covers WS pairing, searching, opponent_input relay, state relay, opponent_left, cancel. Frontend multi-context tests need to expose engine via a React fiber lookup init script since engineRef is not on window. Guest is always paired second; host controls left player. All checks passed.
